Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
characterization

PAW/PBE/HSE06 calculations and full lattice/position relaxation

PAW/PBE/HSE06 calculations and full lattice/position relaxation. VASP PAW with PBE and HSE06; relax both lattice constants and positions until each Hellmann–Feynman force is below 0.01 eV/Å. Different k-meshes are assigned by composition, not swapped. Missing fields: relaxed coordinate files, complete convergence settings.
